bib.title: Language Is Not All You Need: Aligning Perception with Language Models

question: Can a language model trained from scratch on web-scale interleaved text-image, image-caption and text data perceive images, follow instructions and learn in context across language and multimodal tasks?
hypothesis: Aligning perception with LLMs gives zero-shot and few-shot multimodal ability and cross-modal transfer, including better visual commonsense than a text-only LLM.
contributions: KOSMOS-1, an MLLM trained from scratch on text, image-caption pairs and interleaved image-text data
Evaluation of zero-shot, few-shot and multimodal chain-of-thought prompting across language, perception-language and vision tasks
Evidence of cross-modal transfer in both directions
A 50-example Raven IQ test dataset for nonverbal reasoning

method.summary: A 24-layer MAGNETO Transformer decoder (about 1.3B) with xPos, fed by CLIP ViT-L/14 image embeddings through a Resampler, trained with next-token prediction on text only tokens' loss, for 300k steps. Then continued with language-only instruction tuning. Evaluated by prompting only.
method.task: next-token multimodal language modeling; zero/few-shot evaluation

datasets.name: Text corpora (subset of The Pile, CC-2020-50, CC-2021-04, CC-Stories, RealNews)
datasets.size: about 360B tokens total training across all sources; per-source tokens in Table 20 (e.g. CC-2021-04 82.6B)
datasets.source: The Pile (excl. GitHub, arXiv, Stack Exchange, PubMed Central), Common Crawl
datasets.preprocessing: deduplicated and near-duplicates purged, filtered to exclude downstream task data

datasets.name: Image-caption pairs
datasets.preprocessing: Conceptual Captions pairs with tags such as <PERSON> discarded

datasets.name: Interleaved image-text
datasets.preprocessing: English only; pages without images dropped; images <64x64 or single-colored dropped; gibberish heuristics; max 5 images per doc; half of single-image docs randomly dropped

datasets.name: Instruction data
datasets.preprocessing: instructions and inputs not in loss

datasets.name: CUB-style bird set
datasets.source: one group from CUB, two from websites

datasets.name: Rendered SST-2 / HatefulMemes / WebSRC / ImageNet / RelativeSize / MemoryColor / ColorTerms / 7 language tasks
datasets.size: RelativeSize 486 pairs from 41 objects; ImageNet 50k val

models.name: KOSMOS-1
models.architecture: MAGNETO Transformer causal decoder, xPos, CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder + Resampler
models.init_from: trained from scratch (CLIP ViT-L/14 pretrained, all frozen except last layer)

models.name: LLM baseline
models.architecture: language model trained on same text corpora, same setup

models.name: Flamingo-3B / 9B, METALM, GIT, CLIP, Frozen, ZeroCap, VLKD, FewVLM, VALM

training.objective: next-token prediction, maximize log-likelihood; only discrete tokens (text) in the loss
training.batch_size: 1.2M tokens (0.5M text, 0.5M image-caption, 0.2M interleaved); Table 18: 256 text, 6,144 image-caption, 128 interleaved

inference.decoding: captioning beam size 5; VQA greedy; ImageNet beam size 2
inference.samples: few-shot demonstrations randomly sampled from training set; number of runs/seeds not stated

other.imagenet_constraint: constrained decoding uses the 1k category names

metrics.name: Accuracy / ROC AUC / EM / F1 / top-1

eval.protocol: single reported number per cell; no seeds, variance or significance tests stated

prompts.text: Question: what is the sentiment of the opinion? Answer: {answer}
Question: does this picture contain real hate speech? Answer: {answer}
{rationale} Question: what is the sentiment of the opinion? Answer: {answer}
Question:what is the name of {general category} in the picture? Answer:
Here are three/four/eight images: ... The following image is: ... Is it correct?

limits: Only a 1.6B model; scaling and speech left as future work (Section 5).
Raven IQ set is 50 examples and the model is near chance (22% vs 17%); authors note a large gap to adults.
No seeds, variance or significance tests; compute and hardware not stated.
Few-shot VQAv2 and k=8 captioning do not improve and trail Flamingo-9B.
Flamingo baselines are prompted with text-only examples in zero-shot, so comparisons are not like-for-like.
Weights not released in paper; 224x224 image resolution.
